sector_news.headline: Dwarka Expressway challenges Gurugram's old luxury addresses after 135% price surge
sector_news.figure: ANAROCK data: Dwarka Expressway corridor (which includes Sector 95) residential prices up 135% over 5 years; average residential prices in the micro-market ~Rs21,700-24,000/sq ft; homes above Rs2.5 Cr now the dominant budget segment, 3BHKs 39% of supply

sector_news.headline: Dwarka Expressway property prices double in 7 years: How infrastructure turned NCR corridor into a wealth creator
sector_news.figure: Anarock report: avg Dwarka Expressway corridor prices rose from Rs5,359/sq ft (2019) to over Rs9,600/sq ft (H1 2024); ~95-105% appreciation overall, accelerating to ~110-120% between 2021 and early 2026
